title: ISBN Validator
description: Validates an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 string (hyphens and spaces ignored, check digit X allowed) using the checksum rules from limeburst/isbn-rs, and converts between the two forms when the ISBN-13 GS1 prefix is 978. ISBN-13 values must start with 978 or 979. Returns validity, detected format, canonical hyphen-free forms, and an error code with message when invalid.

isbn.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, with optional hyphens or spaces. The ISBN-10 check digit may be X or x.
